analysis:
This PR is a documentation-only change to docs/reference/configuration.md. The visible patch updates the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and expands the description of models[].resource_policy_sha256 (line 964). That row now describes how the resource-policy digest is composed: a SHA-256 over a domain string, the arithmetic policy ID/digest, the state semantics and the scheduling policy, joined by U+001F. If the build declares a resident tensor assistant public for the model, the digest also covers an assistant suffix (`qwen27_tensor_assistant_v1`, depth, inventory hash, verification, evidence hash). The doc states this build declares none. Other changed ranges (1104, 1635-1636) appear in the range map, but their patch text is truncated. Unit 7 (base lines 1217+) and the visible base text show no code, no policy and no wire-format changes. Line 1104 in the base text is a pre-existing sentence about tensorAssistant and nativeMember local-only serving, which is consistent with the new text that no public assistant is declared.

Security relevance: this is documentation of a digest input that is pinned by the coordinator's cluster runtime approval (TB-011 and the A-016/A-017 qualification contract). The new text widens the documented digest inputs but changes no control. Because the row says no assistant is declared, it does not claim a new public serving path. I found no regression, no weakened mitigation, no new attack surface and no threat-model invalidation.

Remaining limits: the patch excerpt is truncated, so changes at lines 1635-1636 were not visible. I could not verify that the documented digest composition matches the implementation (ClusterPublicTensorAssistant.resourcePolicyFields) or the coordinator side in darkbloom-platform. That is a documentation-accuracy question for a pass with source access, not a finding here.
